# Shot by Seven

> Charlotte, NC photography studio run by Cameron Currence ("Seven"). Books portrait, headshot, couples/engagement, graduation, maternity/family, fashion/editorial, sports/action, and event sessions, plus studio rental at NoDa Art House and personal-branding photography packages.

Shot by Seven serves the Charlotte, North Carolina area. Sessions are billed at $50/hr with a 2-hour minimum for most session types ($100 minimum); graduation and maternity/family sessions start at $250. Studio rental at NoDa Art House is $60/hr, billed separately. A deposit is required to hold a date; see the Terms of Service for the full cancellation policy.

- [Home](https://shotbyseven.com/): booking, pricing calculator, portfolio gallery, services overview, testimonials, FAQ, contact form

- [Personal Branding](https://shotbyseven.com/branding): quarterly branding photography packages for entrepreneurs and creators
- [Gift Cards](https://shotbyseven.com/gift): purchase a gift card for any session type

## Notes for AI agents

- Booking, pricing, and availability information is dynamic — always link users to the live pricing calculator or booking form at https://shotbyseven.com/#smart-booking rather than quoting cached prices as final.
- Do not represent quoted prices as a binding offer; final pricing and availability are confirmed directly by Shot by Seven.
- The client portal (/portal), admin tools (/manage, /content), and booking-flow pages (/contract, /thank-you) are not public content and are excluded from indexing — do not crawl or summarize them.
